mapper.sql: SELECT t.id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', t.brand, t.model_spec)), ''), NULLIF(t.registration_code, ''), t.id) AS device_name, CASE t.device_type WHEN 1 THEN '自动扶梯' WHEN 2 THEN '垂直电梯' ELSE CONCAT('未知类型(', t.device_type, ')') END AS device_type, t.line_id, l.name AS line_name, t.station_id, s.name AS station_name, t.device_variety_code, t.running_status, t.brand, t.registration_code, t.model_spec, t.location_detail, t.commissioning_date, t.remark FROM metro_device t LEFT JOIN metro_line l ON t.line_id = l.id LEFT JOIN metro_station s ON t.station_id = s.id
